2026 Serato Graduate Programme - Software Development
Serato Limited
Auckland CBD, Auckland
Full time

Serato is one of the world leaders in audio software for professional DJs, producers and musicians. Our Graduate Programme is designed to identify and foster future technical leaders in the organisation. Along with mentorship and a buddy programme, you will be given training opportunities as well as a chance to experience working in different teams and different products.

Note the Graduate Programme commences in mid January.

We are looking for people who:
- Demonstrate passion for technology and music
- Work well with others and have great communication skills
- Are currently studying a relevant discipline such as Computer Science or Engineering with a high GPA (7+)
- Are familiar with Agentic Engineering practices
- Have great potential as future leaders at Serato

What we offer:
- A great workplace culture where everyone has a voice
- A structured graduate programme with mentoring, continuous feedback and opportunities for skills growth
- Opportunity to work on cutting edge software in a dynamic fast-paced industry
- Exposure to skills development on a complex and varied technology stack
- Potential to work in exciting domain areas including cloud services, big data, machine learning, audio, graphics, UI, hardware integration, eCommerce
- Exciting extra-curricular activities and great social gatherings

Requirements:
- You must be legally permitted to work in New Zealand (If not a NZ Citizen or resident, a valid visa that allows you to work in NZ)
- Head office is based in Auckland (CBD) New Zealand - Applicants will need to be able to travel to HQ regularly for work.
- Please attach a cover letter and copy of your academic transcript to the application.
